decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 is down at C590-05, but radio and CMMS agree. The repair is in place, with a likely finish at 09:54 (range 09:45 to 10:00). A loan would have to travel and would arrive about when the repair ends. Central is also already truck-limited (inflow 118 t/h against 91 t/h truck capacity), and its stockpile is at 264 of 450 t. The 238 t left in the stope stays available after the repair, since the stope has hours of loading time left. Pulling LH-08 from development would cost 1.9 oz/h and gain almost nothing. The best move is to make no loans.

Central is truck-limited (inflow 118 vs 91 t/h). Its stockpile is at 278 of 450 t. The three other Central stopes hold 793 t. Trucks can haul about 637 t and the stockpile has room for about 172 t before 17:00, so Central can absorb about 809 t. An extra loader at C590-05 would add almost nothing. The development loaders are worth 1.9 oz/h (LH-08) and 4.0 oz/h (LH-09), and the gain at Central would not cover that cost. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. The LH-04 repair now runs 14:30 to 17:30, likely 15:30. No reserve can be activated, because no stope has stopped and freed a loader. No loans.
